notes.0: Number is core/lore.js#pastDark, shown on the board as 'past the dark: x% (guess)'; moves only with lit lamps, fire level and nights. Rough: tiny by design (3.1e-6 percent start).
notes.21: The rule (two calm nights, nobody fell) is core/habits.js#comfortable, now shown on the board as 'the dark is learning how you play (reasoned)'. LEFT: the live game does not yet re-tune its waves from it; that learning runs in sim/certify.mjs (learn_test2.mjs).
notes.28: Council number = real + a bonus that grows as the real number falls (core/lore.js#soften); after you check, the wrist says nobody cares (afterProof) and the Clerk's lines change. Rough: 'less welcome at dinner' is text only, no seating.
notes.29: Each dawn the wrist gives last night's dry event (10 events, never the same twice in a row). Mayhem itself is the existing night waves; the 'mayhem' event is a line, not a new spawn.
notes.31: Rough: an edge sign inside the gate (client/camp.js#drawEdge), numbers from g.lost. There is no new maze or Rift entrance yet (Rift is another lane or era).
notes.32: Already existed (Camp.startAt, both papers on the desk); this run moved the papers so both read clearly on the desk, and tested and saw it.
notes.33: Wall already existed; added the 'same ordinary Tuesday' line, a test that no theory passes 85 percent, and a played check that finding evidence moves it.
notes.34: Camp rules live in core/camp.js and game.js; solo run proven by sim/economy.mjs through lore_test and a browser run banking alone.
notes.35: Rough: light vs dark is the light rule (in the dark nothing can be killed) plus the board's honest number rising with every lit lamp (played: 3.1e-6 to 4.19e-6). No separate good-vs-evil text on purpose.
notes.36: Rough: the dark has one fixed rate (fuel loss, day 0.4/s, night 1.0/s), a malice-word test over every dark line, and the wrist line when the fire runs low.
notes.37: Rough: the board shows 'held N nights'; nothing says won. The fire decays to nothing without light (tested) and spending has diminishing returns (powerCurve, tested).
notes.41: Board shows 'the fire costs 30 light a day each' and your standing; seen at 1000x900.
notes.42: PAD: lamp placing had no controller path at all (D-pad down picked it, nothing placed it). Added RT to place and LT to put away in client/main.js, then played the debt message on the pad. This replaces the n/a PAD mark.
notes.43: Rough: two jobs from the Clerk (haul 90 light, light 2 more lamps), pay in gear credit, credit buys a full gun top-up (2 credit). PAD proof replaces the n/a mark (F is D-pad right). Credit and job state live on the player and are NOT saved across a reload yet.
notes.44: Seen as standing +400 with normal price and lamps back, played by setting paid above owed (sim/camp_sim.mjs is the 21-day proof).
notes.45: Seen as 'camp pool 340 light' after banking 400 alone with a friend away.
notes.46: Seen as the in-debt board (standing -70, morale 22 percent) next to the paid board (morale 100 percent).
notes.53: Dawn wrist line only for someone who has checked at least once (check count saved in localStorage). The wrist 'shows them anywhere' is that dawn line; no separate wrist odds screen. PAD proof replaces the n/a mark (the check is D-pad right).
notes.55: Rough: core/eras.js gate (robots 30 percent, your verdicts 70 percent, 3 to 5 verdicts needed) fed by sim/eras.mjs into next/era_state.json; next/feedback.json is empty, so the board says era 1 and 'needs 3 more verdicts from you'. Honest, not faked.
notes.57: Banned-hue and contrast tests in lore_test.mjs, and a per-screen pixel check (with a control) in lane_a_play.cjs over 20 screenshots. Also fixed one failing grey (#6f7188 to #8d90a8).
notes.58: Rough: the era table lists tech per era and the board shows the era; only era 1 (scavenged) content exists in the game. Nothing is gated yet because there is no era 2 content.
